    Line Chart¶

    GraphMtplt.graph_line() generates line charts for time series or any indexed dataframe.

    Expected DataFrame¶

    Date          SPX      NASDAQ
2024-01-31    100      150
2024-02-29    105      152
2024-03-31    108      160
    • The index represents the X-axis.
    • The columns represent the data series.

    Basic Example¶

    In [5]:
    Copied! 
    import helpers_ps as hp
import pandas as pd
    import helpers_ps as hp import pandas as pd

    Setting graph theme

    In [6]:
    Copied! 
    hp.set_graph_theme()
    hp.set_graph_theme()

    Creating a pd.Dataframe

    In [7]:
    Copied! 
    df = pd.DataFrame({
    "date": pd.date_range("2024-01-01", periods=12, freq="ME"),
    "return": [0.01, 0.02, -0.005, 0.015, 0.012, 0.018, -0.003, 0.009, 0.011, 0.014, 0.006, 0.013],
    "nav": [101, 103, 101.5, 102, 104, 106, 105, 106.5, 107, 108, 109, 108.5]
}).set_index("date")

display(df)
    df = pd.DataFrame({ "date": pd.date_range("2024-01-01", periods=12, freq="ME"), "return": [0.01, 0.02, -0.005, 0.015, 0.012, 0.018, -0.003, 0.009, 0.011, 0.014, 0.006, 0.013], "nav": [101, 103, 101.5, 102, 104, 106, 105, 106.5, 107, 108, 109, 108.5] }).set_index("date") display(df)

    Creating a simple graph_line()

    In [9]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(
        series=[{
            "ticker":"return"
        }]
    )
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line( series=[{ "ticker":"return" }] ) )

    Multiple Series¶

    Graphing all series in dataframe

    In [11]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line()
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line() )

    Multiple series considering left and right axis

    In [12]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(
        series=[
            {"ticker":"return", "axis_side":"left"},
            {"ticker":"nav", "axis_side":"right"}
        ]
    )
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line( series=[ {"ticker":"return", "axis_side":"left"}, {"ticker":"nav", "axis_side":"right"} ] ) )

    Customize series labels¶

    In [15]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(
        series=[
            {"ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right"},
            {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns"}
        ]
    )
    .add_legend()
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line( series=[ {"ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right"}, {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns"} ] ) .add_legend() )

    Customize Colors¶

    In [16]:

    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(

            {"ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right", "color":"red"},
            {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"}
        ]
    )
    .add_legend()
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line( series=[ {"ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right", "color":"red"}, {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"} ] ) .add_legend() )

    Title, Subtitle, and Source¶

    In [19]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(
        series=[
            {"ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right", "color":"red"},
            {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"}
        ]
    )
    .add_legend()
    .add_title("Portfolio Evolution")
    .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution")
    .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"])
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line( series=[ {"ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right", "color":"red"}, {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"} ] ) .add_legend() .add_title("Portfolio Evolution") .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution") .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"]) )

    Bloomberg Format on X-Axis¶

    In [22]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(
        series=[
            {"ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right", "color":"red"},
            {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"}
        ],
        x_axis={
            "bbg_format":True,
            "tick_step":1
        }
    )
    .add_legend()
    .add_title("Portfolio Evolution")
    .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution")
    .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"])
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line( series=[ {"ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right", "color":"red"}, {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"} ], x_axis={ "bbg_format":True, "tick_step":1 } ) .add_legend() .add_title("Portfolio Evolution") .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution") .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"]) )

    Show Last Value¶

    In [ ]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(
        series=[
            {
                "ticker":"nav", 
                "label":"Net Asset Value", 
                "axis_side":"right", 
                "color":"red",
                "tags":[
                    {
                        "x_values":"last",
                        "template":"{y_value:,.0f}",
                        "tag":{
                            "ubic_etq": (0,10),
                            "fontweight":"bold"
                        }
                    }
                ]
            },
            {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"}
        ],
        x_axis={
            "bbg_format":True,
            "tick_step":1
        }
    )
    .config_yaxis(
        side="left",
        fmt=",.2%"
    )
    .config_yaxis(
        side="right",
        fmt=",.0f"
    )
    .add_legend()
    .add_title("Portfolio Evolution")
    .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution")
    .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"])
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line( series=[ { "ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right", "color":"red", "tags":[ { "x_values":"last", "template":"{y_value:,.0f}", "tag":{ "ubic_etq": (0,10), "fontweight":"bold" } } ] }, {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"} ], x_axis={ "bbg_format":True, "tick_step":1 } ) .config_yaxis( side="left", fmt=",.2%" ) .config_yaxis( side="right", fmt=",.0f" ) .add_legend() .add_title("Portfolio Evolution") .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution") .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"]) )

    Add Horizontal Lines¶

    In [42]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(
        series=[
            {
                "ticker":"nav", 
                "label":"Net Asset Value", 
                "axis_side":"right", 
                "color":"red",
                "tags":[
                    {
                        "x_values":"last",
                        "template":"{y_value:,.0f}",
                        "tag":{
                            "ubic_etq": (0,10),
                            "fontweight":"bold"
                        }
                    }
                ]
            },
            {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"}
        ],
        x_axis={
            "bbg_format":True,
            "tick_step":1
        }
    )
    .config_yaxis(
        side="left",
        fmt=",.2%"
    )
    .config_yaxis(
        side="right",
        fmt=",.0f"
    )
    .add_legend()
    .add_title("Portfolio Evolution")
    .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution")
    .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"])

    .horizontal_lines([100,110], side="right")

    Add Horizontal Guides¶

    In [44]:
    Copied! 
    g = (
    hp.GraphMtplt(df)
    .graph_line(
        series=[
            {
                "ticker":"nav", 
                "label":"Net Asset Value", 
                "axis_side":"right", 
                "color":"red",
                "tags":[
                    {
                        "x_values":"last",
                        "template":"{y_value:,.0f}",
                        "tag":{
                            "ubic_etq": (0,10),
                            "fontweight":"bold"
                        }
                    }
                ]
            },
            {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"}
        ],
        x_axis={
            "bbg_format":True,
            "tick_step":1
        }
    )
    .config_yaxis(
        side="left",
        fmt=",.2%"
    )
    .config_yaxis(
        side="right",
        fmt=",.0f"
    )
    .add_legend()
    .add_title("Portfolio Evolution")
    .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution")
    .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"])
    .horizontal_lines([0])
    .horizontal_lines([100,110], side="right")
    .horizontal_guides()
    .vertical_guides()
)
    g = ( hp.GraphMtplt(df) .graph_line( series=[ { "ticker":"nav", "label":"Net Asset Value", "axis_side":"right", "color":"red", "tags":[ { "x_values":"last", "template":"{y_value:,.0f}", "tag":{ "ubic_etq": (0,10), "fontweight":"bold" } } ] }, {"ticker":"return", "label":"Daily Returns", "color":"green"} ], x_axis={ "bbg_format":True, "tick_step":1 } ) .config_yaxis( side="left", fmt=",.2%" ) .config_yaxis( side="right", fmt=",.0f" ) .add_legend() .add_title("Portfolio Evolution") .add_subtitle("Description of portfolio evolution") .add_source(["Source: Bloomberg", "(C) Helpers_ps"]) .horizontal_lines([0]) .horizontal_lines([100,110], side="right") .horizontal_guides() .vertical_guides() )
